status: design specification; group mixing and split broods chosen by user; not implemented

roundBroodSize.draw: fresh uniform integer, inclusive; total across selected complete jars

allocationRule: One selected complete jar gets the full brood. Two split equally; for an odd total give the extra baby to a randomly chosen jar with equal probability.
incompleteJarRule: Show before breeding and exclude from allocation. No complete selected jar means no breeding round.
parentRule: For each baby independently choose one unordered pair uniformly within its assigned jar; randomly assign parental transmission order, then inherit one gamete from each actual parent.
exclusivePairRule: Place exactly two beetles in a separate jar. Only those two parent its assigned offspring.
arrivalRule: Shuffle arrival order into the shared tank without changing source jar or parentage.
tankFullRule: Keep new offspring in the visible nursery until tank space is available.
